headline: Thundershowers and gusty wind around Krabi and Phi Phi this week; heaviest rain expected 7–9 Nov.

warnings.title: Flood watch, southern provinces incl. Krabi
warnings.detail: DDPM, 5–9 Nov: risk of flash floods and run-off; heaviest rain 7–9 Nov.

warnings.title: Thundershowers with gusty wind, Krabi / Phuket / Phang Nga
warnings.detail: Thai weather forecast 4 Nov: scattered storms mostly on the Andaman coast.

ferries.detail: No current suspension found; boats can stop in high waves, so confirm with the operator or hotel the day before.

news.title: TMD: heavy to very heavy rain in the South 7–9 Nov
news.detail: Expect wet days around 7–9 Nov; plan indoor options and check boats before travelling.

news.title: Thunderstorms forecast for Krabi, Phuket and Phang Nga
news.detail: Waves above 2 m in storms; boat trips may be cut short or cancelled.

news.title: Suvarnabhumi runway repaired after rain damage
news.detail: Flights were not affected; no action needed.

news.title: Flash flood hit Patong roads in Phuket
news.detail: Water receded within hours; in a downpour, avoid flooded streets and wait indoors.

news.title: Flood alert issued for Phi Phi villages
news.detail: Low-lying areas near Tonsai flood first in heavy rain.

sourceTitle: Nation Thailand: heavy rain in the South 7–9 Nov
